items.text: Lamar Jackson listed QUESTIONABLE (ankle) for Week 7 vs Bengals; status crucial for DFS slate.
items.why: Official ETR Sunday injury dump; Jackson says heading in right direction per reports.
items.implication: If OUT, major downgrade for Ravens pass catchers and streaming QBs; if ACTIVE, full offense boost.
items.opportunity: Monitor pregame; beneficiaries if OUT include backup QB and Zay Flowers volume.

items.text: Puka Nacua QUESTIONABLE (calf); will test pregame after limited practice power/explosion issues.
items.why: McVay: felt lack of power/explosion; majority Thursday practice but no Friday; game-time.
items.implication: If OUT, Stafford targets funnel to TEs/WRs; hierarchy per Levitan: Higbee #1.
items.opportunity: TE target share spike historically when Puka out (37%); Higbee/Parkinson upside.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad) for Week 7 vs Dolphins.
items.why: ETR dump; Berry notes if active start him despite some worry.
items.implication: If ACTIVE, RB1 vs soft MIA; if OUT, handcuff/backup volume.

items.text: OUTs: Brian Robinson, David Montgomery, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, Jeremiyah Love, Zach Charbonnet.
items.why: ETR dump + Schefter comprehensive OUT list; coach confirms for several.
items.implication: Bijan full workload + SF DvP (inflates RB 4.4%); backups elevate; Warren OUT opens IND TE.
items.opportunity: Bijan sweet setup vs SF conceding RB catches; Charbonnet OUT boosts SEA RB.

items.text: Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel ruled OUT for 49ers vs Falcons; entire WR corps hurt.
items.implication: Massive funnel to George Kittle and CMC; National TE Day irrelevant, scheme + injuries drive it.
items.opportunity: Kittle WR-out target monster; CMC slot temptation per CMC smile/quote.

items.text: Bears place TE Cole Kmet on IR; season-ending serious knee injury.
items.why: Schefter + Johnson: big part of heartbeat, stinks; carted Thursday.
items.implication: Loveland maintains/expands role (already 30% ts/19.2 PPR w/ Caleb); Burden more juice less 2/3-TE sets.
items.opportunity: Burden 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR; more snaps/routes expected.

items.text: Davante Adams and Rashee Rice ruled OUT; Adams multi-week hamstring.
items.implication: Rams TE share spike (Higbee preferred); KC WR void filled by others/Worthy.
items.opportunity: Rams 37% TE target share historically without Puka/Adams.

items.text: IN: Josh Jacobs, Quinshon Judkins, Jordan Addison (and Hockenson).
items.why: ETR official IN list; Jacobs facility access prior (meetings/lifting).
items.implication: Jacobs returns but backups poor (Lloyd/Johnson bad EPA); Addison boosts MIN pass game.
items.opportunity: Jacobs full? Monitor role post-layoff; Judkins CLE RB.
items.conflict: Berry hates Jacobs workload question post-layoff.

items.text: If Puka out: Higbee #1 then Mumpfield/Parkinson etc. Kittle nuts due to WR injuries/scheme (not TE Day). Tempted by CMC more slot with WR outs + Black.
items.why: Data/hierarchy; CMC quote smile on slot; rarely buy RB-as-WR but dire WR + Black tempts.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1; CMC receiving upside spike; Higbee if Puka sits.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets to TE/RB slot; 49ers WR void funnel.

items.text: Bijan Robinson full + sweet SF DvP with Brian Robinson OUT; SF inflates opposing RB 4.4% (7th-most), recent RB catches high.
items.why: BRob OUT confirmed; DvP data + recent White/Holani/Harvey/Love production vs SF.
items.implication: RB1 smash spot; full workload expected.
items.opportunity: Carries + receiving vs inflated DvP; goal-line clear.

items.text: Luther Burden elite 2.56 YPRR on 68.8% routes; Kmet IR reduces 2/3-sets for more juice. TreVeyon Henderson just 21% snaps last 3 weeks - downgrade.
items.why: YPRR/snaps data; Kmet absence scheme change.
items.implication: Burden breakout candidate more routes; Henderson sit/flex downgrade.
items.opportunity: Burden route/target expansion; Henderson snap share collapse.

items.text: LOVE Saquon if active vs DAL (efficient, great matchup, back in lineups). Loveland BACK 30% ts/19.2 PPR/6+ rec both games w/ Caleb. AJ Brown 97% routes/33% ts buy despite drops.
items.why: Usage: Loveland post-Caleb return; AJB volume elite; Saquon efficiency + DAL DvP.
items.implication: Start all three; Loveland TE1 upside sustained post-Kmet.
items.opportunity: High target/route shares; RB volume vs soft run D.

items.text: AJ Brown 97% routes/33% ts (buy). When Puka out Rams 37% TE share; Adams multi-week out reinforces Higbee > Parkinson short-term.
items.why: Exact route/target shares; historical TE % without Puka + Adams absence.
items.implication: AJB must-start volume; Rams TE stream/start if Puka sits.
items.opportunity: Elite routes/ts for AJB; TE funnel Rams.

items.text: LOVE: DeVonta Smith, Tucker Kraft, Matthew Golden, Jaylen Warren, Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving (workloads/matchups). HATE: Rome Odunze, Josh Downs, Travis Kelce, Josh Jacobs (matchups/roles/layoff).
items.why: Bears yardage, Lions pass D gift; Warren special; volume/consistency. Hates nasty matchups/low shares/layoff questions.
items.implication: Start loves in flex/TE; fade hates despite name value.
items.opportunity: Warren/Hubbard/Irving big workloads friendly DvP; Kraft/Golden DET secondary.
items.conflict: Jacobs IN but Berry workload concern vs Levitan notes.
